description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveCommentAPI class, which handles REST API endpoints for listing, creating, and managing comments associated with leave requests in the OrangeHRM Leave module. It includes methods for retrieving comments, posting new comments, and access control, along with OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: LeaveCommentAPI
classes.description: API class for managing leave comments, including listing and posting comments to leave requests, with access control and validation, in the OrangeHRM leave module.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of comments associated with a specific leave request, with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new comment on a specific leave request, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method stub for DELETE operation, currently not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the GET request, including sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the POST request, primarily validating the comment content.

methods.name: getCommonValidationRules
methods.description: Defines validation rules common to multiple operations, such as required parameters.

methods.name: setLeaveComment
methods.description: Sets the comment details, creation timestamp, and creator info on a LeaveComment entity.

methods.name: saveLeaveComment
methods.description: Persists a LeaveComment entity using the service's DAO.

methods.name: checkLeaveAccessible
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has access to the leave, throwing an exception if access is denied.
